meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; also called Mispereth at Neh.7.7;
Another name of mis.par (מִסְפָּר "Mispar" H4558)
§ Mispereth = "number"
1) one of those who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
1a) also 'Mispar'
